messages:
Maria: quick question — PR #2487 adds an ExternalSecret that pushes a k8s Secret into payments namespace. can someone eyeball the annotations/roles? i'm worried rotation won't hit the projected volume in the payment worker. here's the externalsecret snippet i added:

```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payments-credentials
  namespace: payments
  annotations:
    secrets.redwood/rotation-window: "1h"
spec:
  refreshInterval: 5m
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-cluster
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: payments-credentials
    template:
      type: Opaque
      metadata:
        annotations:
          backup.redwood/retain: "true"
  data:
  - secretKey: api_key
    remoteRef:
      key: secret/data/payments/api
      property: key
```

Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2487 

Alex: quick skim — two things i noticed:
- we don't tag an owner label (use `secrets.redwood/owner=payments`) so automation can route alerts and ownership lists.
- remoteRef.key pointing to `secret/data/payments/api` is ok for KV v2 but i think our vault mount expects `payments/api` under the `creds/` mount. double-check the mount path in `vault/roles` (common mismatch).

Suggested minimal change:
```diff
 metadata:
-  annotations:
-    secrets.redwood/rotation-window: "1h"
+  annotations:
+    secrets.redwood/rotation-window: "1h"
+  labels:
+    secrets.redwood/owner: payments
 spec:
-  data:
-  - secretKey: api_key
-    remoteRef:
-      key: secret/data/payments/api
-      property: key
+  data:
+  - secretKey: api_key
+    remoteRef:
+      key: creds/payments/api
+      property: key
```

Sam: i'll run a quick reconcile in staging after you push the change. fyi the rotation fanout can cause short bursts to the vault leader — if the payments workers mount many secrets they can trigger backpressure. recommend setting `refreshInterval: 10m` for now or adding jitter in the controller config. i can also run a chaos reconcile to validate. :thumbsup:

Lee: also add an infra-tests case that validates `secrets.redwood/owner` exists for new ExternalSecrets and that `remoteRef.key` matches a known pattern (creds/*). saves us from these PR ping-pongs. i'll prep a tiny github action snippet.

Maria: thanks all — i'll update the PR to add the label and change the key to creds/payments/api, bump refreshInterval to 10m, and add a short note in the PR description about running reconcile in staging. tagging @Alex for final review.

deploy-bot: PR #2487 -> staging pipeline started — job infra/reconcile-staging (job 4521). status: queued.

Alex: if you can, also include a one-liner in the PR changelog about rotation load so SRE knows to watch vault leader metrics during the deploy.

Maria: will do. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
